text: がくしゅうそうちを　ポケモンに　もたせると　その　ポケモンは　たたかわなくても　けいけんちの　わけまえが　もらえます

structure.jp: がくしゅうそうちを　ポケモンに　もたせると
structure.en: if you have a Pokémon hold the Exp. Share

structure.jp: けいけんちの　わけまえが　もらえます
structure.en: can get a share of the Exp. Points

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.span: ポケモンに　もたせる
patterns.explanation: もたせる is もつ 'hold' changed to say you make or let someone hold something; the one who holds gets に. ポケモンに　もたせる = 'have a Pokémon hold it'.

patterns.name: 〜なくても
patterns.explanation: なくても after a verb says 'even if it does not do this'. たたかわなくても = 'even without battling'.

patterns.name: 〜と (if/when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb says that whenever this happens, the next thing follows. もたせると = 'if you have it hold it'.
